sloka: साक्षात् वैश्रवण भ्राता पुत्रो विश्रवसो मुनेः ।यदा न खलु यज्ञस्य विघ्न कर्ता महाबलः ॥१-२०-१८॥
transliteration: sākṣāt vaiśravaṇa bhrātā putro viśravaso muneḥ ।yadā na khalu yajñasya vighna kartā mahābalaḥ ॥1-20-18॥

translations.english: Although endowed with great strength, Ravana, by himself, never created impediments to the sacrifice. But two rakshasas by name Maricha and Subahu are incited by him to cause obstacles".
